answer: According to the lease equity article, Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass lease equity to the customer. Bluewater Leasing instead applies it to the car the customer buys from Northwind, and Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all. Since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount, which reduces the equity the customer receives. Crescent Motor Credit has allowed third-party buyouts since February 1, 2026.
